recipe.title: Satay sauce
recipe.notes: This is from Nadia Lim's Easy Weeknight Meals recipe book.

i.n: garlic, minced - or equivalent crushed garlic
fish sauce or soy sauce, or some of both

method.s: Mix all ingredients together in a small pot over low heat.
Simmer, stirring, until heated through and slightly thickened.
If it becomes too thick, thin out with a splash of water.
